meta.name: ads
meta.description: When the user wants help with paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or other ad platforms. Also use when the user mentions 'PPC,' 'paid media,' 'ROAS,' 'CPA,' 'ad campaign,' 'retargeting,' 'audience targeting,' 'Google Ads,' 'Facebook ads,' 'LinkedIn ads,' 'ad budget,' 'cost per click,' 'ad spend,' 'should I run ads,' 'ABM,' 'account-based marketing,' 'B2B ads,' 'lead quality,' 'negative keywords,' 'Performance Max,' 'thought leader ads,' or 'when should I kill an ad.' Use this for campaign strategy, audience targeting, bidding, and optimization. For bulk ad creative generation and iteration, see ad-creative. For landing page optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 策划和优化各平台付费广告投放
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正经营付费广告,希望提升转化并控制成本
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize paid ad campaigns across platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid ads and want to improve results and efficiency

howto.what: 装好后,Claude会扮演付费广告专家:先询问广告目标、产品、受众和过往投放情况,再根据具体平台(如Google、Meta、LinkedIn)调用对应操作手册,产出预算分配、广告文案、受众定位、账户审计等建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到「PPC」「ROAS」「广告预算」等关键词,或询问Google Ads、Meta等平台的广告活动时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个Google搜索广告系列,月预算2万,目标CPA 80元。
我的Meta广告跑了10天,该扩量还是关掉?
say.note: Claude会加载Meta决策系统,按阈值判断去留。

say.text: 针对SaaS公司写3条LinkedIn广告文案,附带受众定位。
say.note: Claude会调用LinkedIn手册和文案模板。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a paid-ads expert: asks goals/product/audience/past results, loads the relevant platform playbook, then gives budget splits, ad copy, targeting, and audit advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions PPC, ROAS, ad budget, or asks about ad campaigns on Google/Meta/LinkedIn, etc.

say_en.text: Plan a Google Search campaign with a 20k monthly budget and 80 CNY target CPA.
say_en.note: Claude loads the Google playbook and suggests structure, match types, bidding.

say_en.text: My Meta ads ran 10 days—scale them or kill them?
say_en.note: Claude applies the Meta decision system thresholds.

say_en.text: Write 3 LinkedIn ad copy variants for a SaaS company with audience targeting.
say_en.note: Claude uses the LinkedIn playbook and copy templates.
